name: Content Generator — Ideogram + Sharp Compose → Telegram

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM content_plan WHERE status = 'pending' AND scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY scheduled_time LIMIT 1
UPDATE content_plan SET status = 'generating' WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}' RETURNING *

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({"model": "gpt-4o-mini", "temperature": 0.8, "max_tokens": 600, "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": $json.auditor_system_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": 'Plataforma: ' + $json.platform + '
Formato: ' + $json.format + '
Pilar: ' + $json.pillar + '
Tipo: ' + $json.post_type + '
Copy del post (en español, NO incluir en la imagen): ' + $json.copy_text + '
Idea base: ' + $json.image_prompt}]}) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE content_plan SET image_url = '{{ $json.image_url }}' WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}'
UPDATE content_plan SET status = 'review' WHERE id = '{{ $('Componer imagen final (Sharp + SVG)').first().json.id }}'

parameters.name: caption
parameters.value:
={{ (() => { const cta = (($json.cta_url || 'https://jaagsolutions.com') + '').trim(); const copy = $json.copy_text || ''; const hashtags = ($json.hashtags || '').trim(); const showCta = cta && !copy.includes(cta); return '📅 ' + new Date($json.scheduled_date).toLocaleDateString('es-CO', {day:'2-digit', month:'long', year:'numeric'}) + ' ' + ($json.scheduled_time || '') + '
📱 ' + ($json.platform || '').toUpperCase() + ' — ' + ($json.pillar || '') + '

' + [copy, showCta ? cta : '', hashtags].filter(Boolean).join('

'); })() }}

parameters.name: reply_markup
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '✅ Aprobar', callback_data: 'aprobar_' + $json.id }, { text: '❌ Rechazar', callback_data: 'rechazar_' + $json.id }]] }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE content_plan SET status = 'error', error_log = 'Telegram sendPhoto failed' WHERE id = '{{ $('Componer imagen final (Sharp + SVG)').first().json.id }}'

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, text: '🚨 FALLO Telegram send
Fecha: ' + ($('Componer imagen final (Sharp + SVG)').first().json.scheduled_date || '') + ' ' + ($('Componer imagen final (Sharp + SVG)').first().json.scheduled_time || '') + '
Canal: ' + (($('Componer imagen final (Sharp + SVG)').first().json.platform || '').toUpperCase()) + ' - ' + ($('Componer imagen final (Sharp + SVG)').first().json.pillar || '') + '
ID: ' + ($('Componer imagen final (Sharp + SVG)').first().json.id || '') + '

Imagen generada OK pero NO llego a Telegram. Revisar n8n executions y resetear post.' }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE content_plan SET telegram_msg_id = '{{ $json.result.message_id }}' WHERE id = '{{ $('Componer imagen final (Sharp + SVG)').first().json.id }}'
UPDATE content_plan SET status = 'error', error_log = $ocr${{ $json.ocr_error_log }}$ocr$ WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}' RETURNING id, scheduled_date, scheduled_time, platform, pillar, status, error_log

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, text: 'ERROR OCR - post no procesado
Fecha: ' + ($json.scheduled_date || '') + ' ' + ($json.scheduled_time || '') + '
Canal: ' + (($json.platform || '').toUpperCase()) + ' - ' + ($json.pillar || '') + '
Detalle: ' + ($json.error_log || $json.ocr_error_log || '') + '
ID: ' + ($json.id || '') + '

Accion: revisar content_plan, ajustar image_prompt y resetear para reintentar.' }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT id, scheduled_date, scheduled_time, platform, pillar, status, retry_count, error_log FROM content_plan WHERE scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE AND (status IN ('pending','generating','error') OR (status = 'review' AND telegram_msg_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY scheduled_time, id
